Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

This school has students from all backgrounds. Parents of well-to-do and working-class students are encouraged to attend and meet each other at the parent-teacher conferences. working-class parents rarely come to the conferences, but well-to-do parents never miss a chance to meet the teachers. Which parents are attentive and care about their children's schooling?
A. The working-class parents
B. Can't answer
C. The well-to-do parents
